response.rationale: The item was delivered 38 days ago, which exceeds the 30-day standard return window. Per RET-008 (days_since_delivery > 30 and final_sale == False), returns are not accepted more than 30 days after delivery. No higher-priority rule applies: the item is not final sale, not defective, and there is no goodwill grant or fraud hold. The customer's claim of "only a month" does not match the facts.
